gloss: sacred place; holy site; pilgrimage site

definitions.gloss: sacred place; holy site; pilgrimage site
definitions.explanation: A place considered spiritually significant, typically a temple, shrine, or mountain associated with religious practice, miracles, or divine presence. Often visited as part of pilgrimage routes.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{古|ふる}く→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{霊場|れいじょう}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{信仰|しんこう}→信仰：03685_shinkou⟧⟦されて→する：00392_suru⟧きた。
examples.english: This mountain has long been revered as a sacred place.

examples.japanese: {定年後|ていねんご}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{夫婦|ふうふ}→夫婦：03592_fuufu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{四国八十八|しこくはちじゅうはち}か{所|しょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{霊場|れいじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{巡|めぐ}る→巡る：03930_meguru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧だ。
examples.english: Our dream is to make a pilgrimage to all 88 sacred sites of Shikoku together after retirement.

notes:
USAGE:
{霊場|れいじょう} is composed of ⟦{霊|れい}→霊：14667_rei⟧ (spirit, sacred) and {場|じょう} (place). It is associated with both Buddhism and Shinto.

The most famous set of {霊場|れいじょう} in Japan is the {四国八十八|しこくはちじゅうはち}か{所|しょ}{霊場|れいじょう} (88 Sacred Sites of Shikoku), a pilgrimage route associated with the monk {空海|くうかい} ({弘法大師|こうぼうだいし}). Pilgrims who visit all 88 temples are called {遍路|へんろ}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {霊場|れいじょう}{巡|めぐ}り (pilgrimage to sacred sites)
- {霊場|れいじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{巡|めぐ}る→巡る：03930_meguru⟧ (visit sacred sites)
- {霊場|れいじょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参拝|さんぱい}する→参拝する：15627_sanpaisuru⟧ (worship at a sacred site)
- ⟦パワー→パワー：11271_pawaa⟧⟦スポット→スポット：11578_supotto⟧ is the modern informal equivalent for spiritually charged places
